title: The Behavior Change Technique Taxonomy (v1) of 93 Hierarchically Clustered Techniques: Building an International Consensus for the Reporting of Behavior Change Interventions
scope_limitations: Taxonomia padroniza descrição de componentes; não prova eficácia isolada de cada técnica.

title: The Behaviour Change Technique Ontology: Transforming the Behaviour Change Technique Taxonomy v1
scope_limitations: Ontologia de descrição em evolução; não é guia de eficácia clínica.

title: Implementation Intentions and Goal Achievement: A Meta-Analysis of Effects and Processes
scope_limitations: Efeito médio de planos se–então não elimina heterogeneidade, falhas de execução nem necessidade de uma intenção prévia.

title: Does Changing Behavioral Intentions Engender Behavior Change? A Meta-Analysis of the Experimental Evidence
scope_limitations: Mudança de intenção tem efeito médio limitado sobre comportamento; não autoriza inferir execução individual.

title: Unique Effects of Setting Goals on Behavior Change: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
publisher_or_journal: Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology
scope_limitations: Efeito médio pequeno e heterogêneo; moderadores não garantem resultado individual.

title: Self-Regulation Mechanisms in Health Behavior Change: A Systematic Meta-Review of Meta-Analyses, 2006–2017
scope_limitations: Meta-análises subjacentes tinham qualidade variável e poucos testes diretos de mecanismo.

title: Self-Determination Theory Interventions for Health Behavior Change: Meta-Analysis and Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling of Randomized Controlled Trials
publisher_or_journal: Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology
scope_limitations: Efeitos médios pequenos e com viés de publicação/amostras pequenas.

title: A Meta-Analysis of Techniques to Promote Motivation for Health Behaviour Change from a Self-Determination Theory Perspective
scope_limitations: Técnicas foram sintetizadas em intervenções de saúde; efeitos dependem de implementação e contexto.

title: How Are Habits Formed: Modelling Habit Formation in the Real World
scope_limitations: Estudo observacional pequeno; tempo de formação variou amplamente e não define prazo universal.

title: Time to Form a Habit: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Health Behaviour Habit Formation and Its Determinants
scope_limitations: A maioria dos estudos incluídos teve alto risco de viés; comportamentos avaliados foram limitados.

title: Context Stability in Habit Building Increases Automaticity and Goal Attainment
scope_limitations: Dois estudos específicos não justificam causalidade universal em todos os comportamentos.

title: The Nature of Procrastination: A Meta-Analytic and Theoretical Review of Quintessential Self-Regulatory Failure
scope_limitations: Preditores meta-analíticos são associações agregadas e não explicações causais de uma pessoa.

title: Targeting Procrastination Using Psychological Treatments: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
scope_limitations: Poucos ensaios, heterogeneidade e algum risco de viés; não sustenta prescrição clínica pelo produto.

title: Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques
publisher_or_journal: Psychological Science in the Public Interest
scope_limitations: Utilidade varia por material, estudante, tarefa e condição de aprendizagem.

title: Testing (Quizzing) Boosts Classroom Learning: A Systematic and Meta-Analytic Review
scope_limitations: Efeito depende de formato, feedback, correspondência do material e desenho.

title: Systematic Review of Distributed Practice and Retrieval Practice in Health Professions Education
scope_limitations: Escopo é educação de profissões da saúde e os estudos são heterogêneos.

title: Recommended Amount of Sleep for a Healthy Adult: A Joint Consensus Statement
scope_limitations: Recomendação de consenso para adultos saudáveis; não individualiza necessidade nem substitui avaliação.

title: National Sleep Foundation's Updated Sleep Duration Recommendations: Final Report
scope_limitations: Faixas de consenso por idade não são prescrição individual.

title: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour
scope_limitations: Diretriz populacional; progressão e contraindicações individuais exigem avaliação adequada.

title: Adding Physical Activity as an Adult
authors: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
scope_limitations: Orientação geral para adultos; condições crônicas e atividade vigorosa exigem cautela.

title: Self-Compassion, Physical Health, and Health Behaviour: A Meta-Analysis
scope_limitations: Grande parte da síntese é associacional; intervenções de sessão única não tiveram efeito significativo.

title: Relationships Between Perfectionism and Symptoms of Depression, Anxiety and OCD in Adults
scope_limitations: Associação com sintomas não autoriza diagnóstico individual.

title: Suicide: Questions and Answers
scope_limitations: Material informativo global; contatos e fluxos devem ser localizados para o Brasil.

title: Self-Harm: Assessment, Management and Preventing Recurrence (NG225)
authors: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
scope_limitations: Diretriz para profissionais e sistema britânico; adaptar serviços e legislação ao Brasil.

title: Suicídio (Prevenção)
scope_limitations: Página pública brasileira; sinais não devem ser usados isoladamente como predição.

title: Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência — SAMU 192
scope_limitations: Define o serviço brasileiro; disponibilidade e cobertura local ainda podem variar.

title: Lei nº 13.709, de 14 de agosto de 2018 — Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais
scope_limitations: Texto legal exige interpretação e revisão jurídica para decisões de produto.

title: Meditations (public-domain English translation)
A Selection from the Discourses of Epictetus with the Encheiridion
Talks to Teachers on Psychology; and to Students on Some of Life's Ideals
How We Think
Changing Circumstances, Disrupting Habits
publisher_or_journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
scope_limitations: Context-change findings concern observed behaviors and do not establish that every performance failure is environmental.

title: Effective Behavior Change Techniques to Promote Physical Activity in Adults With Overweight or Obesity: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
scope_limitations: Moderator findings are domain- and population-specific and do not isolate a universal graded-task effect.

title: Task Aversiveness and Procrastination: A Multi-Dimensional Approach to Task Aversiveness Across Stages of Personal Projects
scope_limitations: Single undergraduate sample and correlational component structure do not establish individual causation.

title: Temporal Discounting Predicts Procrastination in the Real World
scope_limitations: Correlation depended on a trajectory-based procrastination measure and does not establish individual causality.

title: A Meta-Analytic and Conceptual Update on the Associations Between Procrastination and Multidimensional Perfectionism
scope_limitations: Perfectionistic concerns and strivings have different associations; the construct must not be treated as unitary or causal.

title: Building a Practically Useful Theory of Goal Setting and Task Motivation: A 35-Year Odyssey
scope_limitations: Classic review draws heavily on performance settings; moderators and task complexity constrain generalization.

title: Goal Conflict and Psychological Well-Being: A Meta-Analysis
scope_limitations: Associations vary by measurement and sample and do not prove that conflict causes individual distress.

title: Interference and Facilitation Among Personal Goals: Differential Associations With Subjective Well-Being and Persistent Goal Pursuit
scope_limitations: Multimethod associations distinguish interference and facilitation but do not prescribe a universal resolution strategy.

title: Exploring the Planning Fallacy: Why People Underestimate Their Task Completion Times
publisher_or_journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
scope_limitations: Foundational bounded-task studies do not yield a universal correction factor for individual estimates.

title: If You Don't Want to Be Late, Enumerate: Unpacking Reduces the Planning Fallacy
scope_limitations: Unpacking improved some estimates, especially for multifaceted tasks; it is not a guaranteed debiasing method.

title: Day-to-Day Fluctuations in Motivation Drive Effort-Based Decision-Making
publisher_or_journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
scope_limitations: Effort-choice findings over 15 days do not establish effects for every routine or explain persistent low motivation.

title: Does Monitoring Goal Progress Promote Goal Attainment? A Meta-Analysis of the Experimental Evidence
scope_limitations: Monitoring interventions and reporting conditions varied; effects do not make every metric valid or useful.

title: Similarity Matters: A Meta-Analysis of Interleaved Learning and Its Moderators
scope_limitations: Average effects reverse or disappear for some materials; material and similarity structure are necessary moderators.

title: On the Difficulty of Mending Metacognitive Illusions: A Priori Theories, Fluency Effects, and Misattributions of the Interleaving Benefit
scope_limitations: Experiments concern specific inductive-learning tasks and do not make all subjective fluency misleading.

title: The Importance of Sleep Regularity: A Consensus Statement of the National Sleep Foundation Sleep Timing and Variability Panel
scope_limitations: Consensus supports regularity but preserves catch-up-sleep qualifications and does not define an individual treatment plan.

title: Sleep Timing, Sleep Consistency, and Health in Adults: A Systematic Review
scope_limitations: Evidence quality ranged from very low to moderate and no universal timing-variability threshold was identified.
